linkedService/assignment2service.json.secretName: Name of a Key Vault secret holding the complete connection string, not the secret value.

linkedService/assignment2sinkservice.jso.url: Storage account endpoint; grant factory managed identity Storage Blob Data Contributor and required ADLS ACLs.

linkedService/CourseworkKeyVault.json.baseUrl: Key Vault URL. Grant factory identity permission to read the named secrets.

dataset/assignment2db.json.container: Existing container/filesystem for this dataset (original coursework label: game-sales).

dataset/assignment2sink.json.fileSystem: Existing container/filesystem for this dataset (original coursework label: game-sales).

Assignment 2.ipynb.input_csv: Databricks widget: full path to input CSV in an authorized Volume or storage location.
Assignment 2.ipynb.output_dir: Databricks widget: fresh output directory outside the input directory; existing output is not overwritten.
